title: Harbour Youth Volunteering Programme
intro: 一封招募信、一張活動時間表——DSE 常見的實用文本組合。請根據兩份材料作答。
passage:
Dear students,

Thank you for your interest in the Harbour Youth Volunteering Programme. Since 2015 we have placed more than 900 secondary school volunteers with community organizations across the city. Below are the details of this year's intake, which begins on 4 July.

Volunteers commit to ONE service day per week for eight weeks. Places are limited to 120 students, and places are allocated in order of application, NOT by interview. All volunteers must attend the Orientation and Safety Workshop on 4 July — attendance is compulsory; volunteers who miss it cannot be placed, and the fee of $150 will not be refunded.

Please note our new policy this year: applications must be submitted online at www.harbouthyouth.org/apply. Paper forms and email applications will not be processed. Applications open on 1 June at 9 a.m. and close when all places are filled. Last year, all places were gone within six days, so we encourage early applications. Students aged 15-18 are welcome; those under 16 need a signed parental consent form uploaded during application.

We look forward to working with you.

Ms. Karen Leung
Programme Coordinator

HARBOUR YOUTH VOLUNTEERING PROGRAMME — SCHEDULE OVERVIEW

Week 1 (4 Jul, Sat) — Orientation and Safety Workshop, Harbour Community Centre, 10 a.m. - 1 p.m.
Weeks 2-9 — Service placement, one day per week chosen by the volunteer (weekday afternoons or Saturday mornings)
Week 10 (12 Sep, Sat) — Closing Sharing Session & Certificate Ceremony, City Hall Exhibition Hall, 2 p.m. - 5 p.m.

Placement options:
A. Elderly Care Helpers — visit care homes, chat and play board games with elderly residents
B. Story Angels — read English storybooks to children aged 4-6 at public libraries (Saturday mornings only)
C. Harbour Clean-Up Crew — beach and mangrove clean-ups (Saturday mornings only, physically demanding)
D. Museum Guides — assist visitors and support weekend workshops at the City Maritime Museum

Requirements: Option B requires volunteers to pass a simple spoken-English assessment at the Workshop. Option C requires a basic fitness level; volunteers must bring their own sports shoes. Option D requires attendance at BOTH Saturday mornings AND Sunday afternoons in Weeks 5 and 6 for festival events.

All volunteers receive a certificate of 40 service hours upon completing the programme. Students seeking additional hours may apply for the School Holiday Extension in December.

For enquiries: WhatsApp 5512-3304 (text only, no calls), or email info@harbouthyouth.org
Office hours: Mon-Fri 9 a.m. - 5 p.m.

questions.q: A Form 3 student wants to volunteer. What must the student do during application?
options: Upload a signed parental consent form
Submit a paper form by email
questions.note: 根據信件第四段：16 歲以下須上載家長簽署的同意書。A 面試與『NOT by interview』矛盾；B『上網繳費』無據（$150 是 Workshop 費用且不退）；D 與『Paper forms... will not be processed』矛盾。

questions.q: Why does Ms. Leung encourage students to apply early?
options: Early applicants can choose their service day before others
Places are allocated on a first-come-first-served basis and filled up quickly last year
The online system closes automatically one week after opening
Late applicants will be charged a higher fee
questions.note: 信件第三、四段：名額按申請次序分配（in order of application），去年六天內額滿——故鼓勵早申請。A『可先選時段』無據；C 系統是額滿即關，非固定一週；D 無差別收費。

questions.q: Danny is a strong swimmer who is free only on Saturday mornings. Which placement option(s) can he apply for?
questions.note: B 與 C 均為 Saturday mornings only，符合他的時間；D 要求 Weeks 5-6 同時出席周六上午與周日下午，Danny 周日不空，排除 D。C 的體能要求他符合（strong swimmer），B 僅需通過簡單英語口語評估。

questions.q: Which of the following is TRUE according to the materials?
options: Volunteers serve at their placements for nine weeks in total
The Closing Ceremony is held at the Harbour Community Centre
A volunteer who misses the Workshop on 4 July cannot join the programme
Enquiries should be made by calling the office during office hours
questions.note: 信件第三段：Orientation 為 compulsory，缺席者不能被安置（cannot be placed）。A 服務期為 Weeks 2-9 共八週；B 儀式在 City Hall Exhibition Hall，非社區中心；D 明言 WhatsApp text only, no calls。
